description: Golden outcomes of the build.* commands for the build-system fixtures. Each case sends `request` with the named fixture manifest and build system, and expects the whole outcome envelope. `${workspace}` stands for an absolute, existing workspace root the test creates; it is substituted in requests and expectations alike.
